notes.decision: Both Greek loanwords (χρόνος / κλῆρος) recur throughout the page in apparent semi-synonymy. ⲭⲣⲟⲛⲟⲥ = 'time/era' (the temporal extent), ⲕⲁⲗⲣⲟⲥ (κλῆρος) = 'lot, allotted portion, term' (the assigned segment). The text distinguishes them: there are three κλῆροι/χρόνοι spanning from the First Man through the establishment of the cosmos by Father+Mother of Life through the Ambassador's revelation until Panaretos. I render ⲭⲣⲟⲛⲟⲥ as 'time' and ⲕⲁⲗⲣⲟⲥ as 'term' (allotted span).
Greek Παναρετος ('all-virtuous'). Manichaean eschatological figure who comes at the end against the bōlos. Retained as transliterated proper name 'Panaretos' to flag the technical-onomastic status.

ⲁⲍⲣⲏⲓ̈ = ⲉϩⲣⲁⲓ̈ ('upward'); with ⲍⲙ̄ ('upon, against'). Translated 'come up against the clod' — Panaretos rises up against the bōlos at the eschatological consummation. Preserves vertical-directional semantics required by Manichaean cosmic physics.
Reading as ϩⲟⲩⲟ + ⲥⲁⲃⲕ ('more, lesser') = comparative 'is lesser' — fits the rhetorical structure where the middle period is being measured against the first.
ϩⲁⲥⲕ from ϩⲱⲥⲕ 'delay, prolong, stretch out' + 'in much/excess' = 'much longer.' The duration of the first man's time exceeds the Ambassador's term.
Lexeme uncertain. Possibly ⲁⲟⲩⲗⲉ 'shoot, sucker' (vegetative growth) — fits the agricultural register established in earlier kephalaia where men become trees/shoots. Tentative.
Lyc reflex of ϩⲗⲟϭ 'sweet, sweetness.' 'Land of sweetness' = Land of Light, paralleling the paired terminology ⲡⲕⲁⲍ ⲉⲧⲁⲛⲓⲧ in earlier kephalaia.
